A03 \"Red Alert\" Sniper Rifle.title: A03 "Red Alert" Sniper Rifle
A03 \"Red Alert\" Sniper Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
A03 \"Red Alert\" Sniper Rifle.lead: The A03 "Red Alert" Sniper Rifle is a sniper rifle manufactured by Gemini .
A03 \"Red Alert\" Sniper Rifle.desc: Devastate at distance with the A03 sniper rifle. Masterfully designed by Gemini's Tevarin co-founder Clem, the weapon balances a stylish and ergonomic design with a powerful ballistic punch. The A03 delivers an impressive rate of fire for a sniper rifle that sacrifices accuracy for urgency when successive shots are required. Considering its renowned design and unique features, it's easy to see why the A03 has become a favorite of security professionals across the empire. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.
A03 \"Red Alert\" Sniper Rifle.desc_ko: A03 저격소총으로 먼 거리에서 적을 쓸어버리세요. Gemini의 테바린 공동 창업자 클렘이 정교하게 설계한 이 총은 세련되고 인체공학적인 디자인과 강력한 탄도 위력을 겸비했습니다. 연속 사격이 필요할 때 정확도보다 속도를 택해, 저격소총치고 인상적인 연사력을 보여 줍니다. 이름난 디자인과 독특한 특징 덕분에 제국 전역의 보안 전문가들이 아끼는 총이 된 것도 당연합니다. 'Red Alert' 에디션은 회색과 강렬한 빨강을 섞어 대담하고 역동적인 디자인을 완성했습니다.

missions.ko_desc:
호크로우 기관 
사건 파일 #JD10285
수사 책임자: 아르켄 말로

사건 요약: 
한 의뢰인이 호크로우에게 악명 높은 과학자 <EM4>로건 요리트 박사</EM4>에 대한 완전한 서류를 작성해 달라고 요청했습니다. Associated Science & Development의 라자루스 연구소에서 발생한 사건의 범인으로 지목된 의뢰인은 로건 박사와 그의 연구에 대해 더 자세히 알고 싶어 합니다. 

계약 조사관 활동: 
조리트 박사가 이전에 수석 과학자로 근무했던 ASD의 폐쇄된 <EM4>오닉스 시설</EM4>에 접근합니다. 그곳에 도착하시면 연구소의 인사 파일을 찾아 <EM4>열람</EM4>하여 그곳에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 간략하게 파악해 주시기 바랍니다.

추가 참고 사항:
시설이 소등되면서 현장으로 통하는 QT 비콘이 비활성화되었으므로 마지막 구간은 수동으로 이동해야 합니다.

ASD가 공식적으로 시설을 폐쇄했지만, 여전히 주의가 필요합니다. 연구실 자체뿐만 아니라 주변 지역에 최근 방문객의 흔적이 있을 수 있습니다. 불법 거주자나 불법 거주자가 있을 수도 있습니다.

직원 ID 코드도 확보했으니, 근무 중이시라면 해당 시설의 컴퓨터에 접속하실 수 있습니다.

또한, 오닉스 시설에는 대형 격납고만 있으므로 이동 계획을 신중하게 세우시기 바랍니다.
missions.en_desc:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
A client has requested that Hockrow compile a complete dossier on infamous scientist <EM4>Dr. Logan Jorrit</EM4>. Believed responsible for the incidents at Associated Science & Development’s Lazarus site, the client is eager to get a broader view of Dr. Logan and his research.

Contract Investigator Actions: 
Gain access to ASD’s shuttered <EM4>Onyx Facility</EM4> where Dr. Jorrit was formerly the Lead Scientist.  Once there, locate and <EM4>access the research lab’s personnel files</EM4> so that we can get an overview of what was going on there.

Additional Notes:
The QT beacon to the site was deactivated when the facility went dark so you'll have to fly the last leg manually.

While ASD has formally closed the facility, caution is still advised. Not only may the labs themselves be hazardous, but the surrounding area shows signs of recent visitors. Scavengers or squatters may be on site.

I've also managed to wrangle an employee ID code for you so as long as you're on the job, you'll be able to access the computers there. 

Additionally, Onyx Facility only has large hangars available, so plan your travel appropriately.

사건 업데이트: 
오닉스 시설에서 회수된 인사 파일을 통해 요리트 박사가 최근 현장을 방문하여 파일에 접근했다는 사실을 알게 되었습니다. 다음 단계는 이 단서를 따라 요리트 박사가 이전 연구실에서 정확히 무엇을 했는지 알아내는 것입니다.

QT 문제에 대한 해결책을 찾았으므로 이제부터 현장으로 바로 이동하실 수 있습니다.

현장에 적대적인 세력이 있을 수 있으니 주의하십시오.

대형 격납고에 보관할 수 있는 차량을 타고 오닉스로 이동하십시오.
missions.en_desc:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
From the personnel files recovered at the Onyx Facility, we have now learned that Dr. Jorrit has recently visited the site and accessed files while there. The next step will be to follow this lead and try to learn exactly what Dr. Jorrit was doing in his old lab.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Engineering</EM4> wing and <EM4>access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
I've found a work around for the QT issue so you'll be able to travel directly to the site from now on.

Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Ace Interceptor Helmet.title: Ace Interceptor Helmet
Ace Interceptor Helmet.subtitle: Helmet

It features precisely layered plating to protect the head from a variety of combat and environmental hazards and an impact resistant, anti-glare visor over the eyes. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

Aegis Idris-P Wikelo War Special.title: Idris-P
Aegis Idris-P Wikelo War Special.subtitle: Aegis Dynamics
Aegis Idris-P Wikelo War Special.lead: The Idris-P (Peacekeeper) is a variant of the Idris frigate developed by Aegis Dynamics . This vessel is specifically tailored for civilian use, having had all military-grade equipment removed. Featuring two hangars capable of housing three small vessels and one snub craft, along with enhanced cargo capacity and numerous gun turrets, it serves as an optimal choice for militia, corporate, and private entities in various different roles.

Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special.title: Sabre Firebird
Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special.subtitle: Aegis Dynamics
Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special.lead: The Sabre Firebird is a medium fighter belonging to the Sabre series, developed by Aegis Dynamics . Designed for swift and relentless assaults using its customized missile system, this high-velocity combat aircraft excels in launching rapid barrages. Its primary objective is to neutralize potential dangers swiftly, leaving adversaries with minimal time to respond. This versatile fighter is equally proficient in embarking on extended-range missions or swiftly mobilizing to safeguard your operational headquarters.

Aegis Sabre Firebird Wikelo War Special.lead_ko: Aegis Dynamics의 Sabre 계열 중형 전투기. 개조된 미사일 시스템으로 빠르고 집요한 공격에 특화돼 있습니다. 위켈로 'War Special' 버전.

Aegis Sabre Peregrine Wikelo Speedy Spec.subtitle: Aegis Dynamics

The Peregrine represents the pinnacle of speed among Sabre models, utilizing the renowned military-derived Sabre chassis and refining it for unparalleled velocity. This already aerodynamic structure is enhanced by custom thrusters and meticulously optimized engines, propelling the Peregrine's straight-line speed into an entirely new category.

Anvil Asgard Wikelo War Special.title: Asgard
Anvil Asgard Wikelo War Special.subtitle: Anvil Aerospace
Anvil Asgard Wikelo War Special.lead: The Asgard is a combat vehicle lander manufactured by Anvil Aerospace . Designed to be the next evolution in ground vehicle transport, the Asgard represents a significant advancement that is tailored to meet the requirements of contemporary military operations. It features a rapid-loading ramp, a roomy interior specifically engineered to safely house your chosen assault vehicle, and a comprehensive array of weapons to ensure entry into the most fiercely contested drop zones.
Anvil Asgard Wikelo War Special.lead_ko: Anvil Aerospace의 전투 차량 수송 착륙선. 지상 차량 수송의 차세대 모델입니다. 위켈로 'War Special' 버전.

Anvil F7 Hornet Mk Wikelo.title: F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II
Anvil F7 Hornet Mk Wikelo.subtitle: Anvil Aerospace
Anvil F7 Hornet Mk Wikelo.lead: The F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II is a medium sized fighter variant of the F7C Hornet Mk II , developed by Anvil Aerospace . Anvil has enhanced their esteemed military-class superiority fighter by integrating the latest technological advancements, resulting in the F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II. This variant preserves the dual cockpit and ball turret features that contributed to the formidable reputation of its predecessor in combat scenarios.
Anvil F7 Hornet Mk Wikelo.lead_ko: Anvil Aerospace F7C Hornet Mk II의 중형 전투기 변형 F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II. 군용 제공 전투기에 최신 기술을 더했습니다. 위켈로 버전.

Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.title: F8C Lightning
Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.subtitle: Anvil Aerospace
Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.lead: The Anvil Aerospace F8C Lightning is the civilian variant of the F8A Lightning space superiority fighter that is used by the United Empire of Earth Navy . It closely mimics the military specs of the original F8A, and has been used in lines of defense against Vanduul invaders. It was made available in extremely limited numbers to the civilian market by Anvil to celebrate the debut of the F8A in the UEE Navy.
Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.key: Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special
Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.lead_ko: UEE 해군 제공 전투기 F8A Lightning의 민간형. 원형의 군용 사양을 거의 그대로 따릅니다. 위켈로 'Sneak Special' 버전.
Anvil F8C Lightning Wikelo Sneak Special.ko_name: 앤빌 F8C 라이트닝 위켈로 스닉 스페셜

Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.title: Terrapin Medic
Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.subtitle: Anvil Aerospace
Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.lead: The Terrapin Medic is a medical support vessel designed by Anvil Aerospace . Featuring a tier 2 medical bed, this ship is adept at securely extracting injured persons from hazardous situations, thanks to its durable armor and shielding systems. Functioning as both a compact frontline trauma center and a resilient search and rescue craft, the Terrapin Medic and its crew are dedicated to preserving lives and ensuring operational continuity in the most challenging environments and circumstances.
Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.key: Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Special
Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.lead_ko: Anvil Aerospace의 의료 지원 함선. 2단계 의료 침대와 튼튼한 장갑·실드로 위험 지역에서 부상자를 안전하게 구출합니다. 위켈로 'Savior Special' 버전.
Anvil Terrapin Medic Wikelo Savior Speci.ko_name: 앤빌 테라핀 메딕 위켈로 구세주 스페셜

Argo ATLS.title: ATLS
Argo ATLS.subtitle: Argo Astronautics
Argo ATLS.lead: The ATLS ( Assisted Transport and Loading System ) is a power suit manufactured by Argo Astronautics . It is designed to assist individuals in lifting heavy loads when manual handling poses safety risks and the use of a vehicle is not feasible. This durable exo-frame incorporates a patented structural support mechanism along with a custom tractor system, which greatly enhances the user's strength, stability, and load-bearing capabilities.
Argo ATLS.lead_ko: Argo Astronautics의 파워 슈트 ATLS(Assisted Transport and Loading System). 사람이 직접 들기 위험한 무거운 짐을 옮기도록 돕습니다.

Argo ATLS GEO IKTI.title: ATLS GEO IKTI
Argo ATLS GEO IKTI.subtitle: Argo Astronautics
Argo ATLS GEO IKTI.lead: The ATLS GEO IKTI ( Banu : ikti ( ikti ) ; literally Weapon; ) is a combat retrofit of the Argo Astronautics ATLS GEO power suit developed by Wikelo Emporium .
Argo ATLS GEO IKTI.lead_ko: 위켈로 엠포리엄이 Argo ATLS GEO 파워 슈트를 전투용으로 개조한 버전. 'IKTI'는 바누어로 '무기'라는 뜻입니다.

Argo ATLS IKTI.title: ATLS IKTI
Argo ATLS IKTI.subtitle: Argo Astronautics
Argo ATLS IKTI.lead: The ATLS IKTI ( Banu : ikti ( ikti ) ; literally Weapon; ) is a combat retrofit of the Argo Astronautics ATLS power suit performed by Wikelo Emporium .

Argo RAFT Wikelo Work Special.title: RAFT
Argo RAFT Wikelo Work Special.subtitle: Argo Astronautics
Argo RAFT Wikelo Work Special.lead: The RAFT (Reinforced Advanced Freight Transport) is a medium cargo hauler developed by Argo Astronautics . This compact vehicle is designed to transport six standardized 32 SCU cargo containers , maximizing payload capacity and minimizing complications. Eliminate the hassle of hand-loading crates; the RAFT allows for efficient loading and unloading, preparing you for your next task. With reinforced shields, a robust weapons system, and a wide range of countermeasures, the RAFT ensures secure delivery of your cargo.
Argo RAFT Wikelo Work Special.lead_ko: Argo Astronautics의 중형 화물선 RAFT. 32 SCU 표준 화물 컨테이너 6개를 실을 수 있습니다. 위켈로 'Work Special' 버전.

BUL-H4 Armor.title: BUL-H4 Armor
BUL-H4 Armor.subtitle: Undersuit
BUL-H4 Armor.lead: The BUL-H4 Armor is a super heavy armor suit manufactured by Clark Defense Systems ; its synthetic polymer plating absorbs impacts while a power-assisted frame carries the weight.
BUL-H4 Armor.desc: Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. Utilizing advanced synthetic polymers, impacts are significantly mitigated transforming the wearer into a bulwark of defense. The armor's power-assisted frame helps maintain mobility, offsetting the heavy weight of the suit.
BUL-H4 Armor.lead_ko: Clark Defense Systems의 초중량 방어구 슈트. 합성 폴리머 장갑이 충격을 흡수하고, 동력 보조 프레임이 무게를 받쳐 줍니다.
BUL-H4 Armor.desc_ko: BUL-H4 시리즈로 개인 보호의 기준을 새로 쓰세요. 첨단 합성 폴리머가 충격을 크게 줄여 착용자를 든든한 방벽으로 만들어 줍니다. 동력 보조 프레임이 무거운 슈트의 무게를 상쇄해 기동성을 유지해 줍니다.

BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.title: BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo
BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.subtitle: Undersuit
BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.lead: The BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo is the Snow Camo edition of the BUL-H4 Armor , a super heavy armor suit manufactured by Clark Defense Systems , in a white digital camo pattern for frozen environments.
BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.desc: Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. Utilizing advanced synthetic polymers, impacts are significantly mitigated transforming the wearer into a bulwark of defense. The armor's power-assisted frame helps maintain mobility, offsetting the heavy weight of the suit. Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.
BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.lead_ko: Clark Defense Systems의 초중량 방어구 BUL-H4의 설상 위장(Snow Camo) 에디션. 추운 환경에 맞춘 흰색 디지털 위장 무늬입니다.
BUL-H4 Armor Snow Camo.desc_ko: BUL-H4 시리즈로 개인 보호의 기준을 새로 쓰세요. 첨단 합성 폴리머가 충격을 크게 줄여 착용자를 든든한 방벽으로 만들어 줍니다. 동력 보조 프레임이 무거운 슈트의 무게를 상쇄해 기동성을 유지해 줍니다. 흰색 디지털 위장 무늬의 Snow Camo 에디션은 얼어붙은 환경에서 사냥감을 쫓기에 제격입니다.

BUL-H4 Helmet.title: BUL-H4 Helmet
BUL-H4 Helmet.subtitle: Helmet
BUL-H4 Helmet.lead: The BUL-H4 Helmet is the helmet of the BUL-H4 super heavy armor , manufactured by Clark Defense Systems ; its quad-visor slots feed a single combined image through CDS's PROWL hardware.
BUL-H4 Helmet.desc: Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. CDS's proprietary PROWL hardware combines the video input from quad-visor slots to create one singular feed, offering uninhibited vision without compromising on safety.
BUL-H4 Helmet.lead_ko: Clark Defense Systems의 초중량 방어구 BUL-H4의 헬멧. 네 개의 바이저 슬롯 영상을 CDS PROWL 장치가 하나로 합쳐 보여 줍니다.
BUL-H4 Helmet.desc_ko: BUL-H4 시리즈로 개인 보호의 기준을 새로 쓰세요. CDS의 독자적인 PROWL 장치가 네 개의 바이저 슬롯 영상을 하나로 합쳐, 안전은 그대로 지키면서 막힘없는 시야를 제공합니다.

Berry Blend Smoothie.title: Berry Blend Smoothie
Berry Blend Smoothie.subtitle: Drink
Berry Blend Smoothie.lead: The Berry Blend Smoothie is a drink available in the Star Citizen universe, sold as a fruity blended beverage that helps restore the player's thirst .
Berry Blend Smoothie.desc: A smoothie made with a fresh blend of berries.
Berry Blend Smoothie.lead_ko: 베리를 갈아 만든 음료. 마시면 갈증이 회복됩니다.

Bluemoon Fungus.title: Bluemoon Fungus
Bluemoon Fungus.subtitle: Organic
Bluemoon Fungus.lead: Bluemoon Fungus is an organic commodity harvested across the 'verse.
Bluemoon Fungus.desc: Preferring to spore in the depths of dark caves, the fruiting mushrooms of the Bluemoon fungus are often collected as a highly-valued petroleum-free lubricant used across a wide-variety of industries.
Bluemoon Fungus.lead_ko: 우주 곳곳에서 채집할 수 있는 유기물 원자재(버섯).
Bluemoon Fungus.desc_ko: 어두운 동굴 깊은 곳에서 포자를 퍼뜨리는 블루문 균류의 버섯은, 여러 산업에서 귀하게 쓰이는 석유 없는 윤활제로 자주 채집됩니다.

Bokto Arms.title: Bokto Arms
Bokto Arms.subtitle: Arm armor
Bokto Arms.lead: The Bokto Arms is an arms armor manufactured by Quirinus Tech .
Bokto Arms.desc: This Antium Armor was modified from its original version. Carefully-selected fangs and bones were mounted to the set to give it a primal look.
Bokto Arms.desc_ko: 원래 버전을 개조한 Antium 방어구. 엄선한 송곳니와 뼈를 달아 원시적인 느낌을 냈습니다.

Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.title: Boomtube "Clanguard" Rocket Launcher
Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.subtitle: Personal weapon
Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.lead: The Boomtube "Clanguard" Rocket Launcher is a scrap rocket launcher modifed with Vanduul plating by Wikelo .
Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.desc: Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best. The Clanguard version has been modified with Vanduul materials and alien artifacts.
Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.lead_ko: 위켈로가 반두르 장갑판으로 개조한 고물 로켓 발사기 Boomtube.
Boomtube \"Clanguard\" Rocket Launcher.desc_ko: 조준할 시간이 어디 있어요? 무장 거리만 확보되면 마음에 안 드는 쪽으로 Boomtube 발사기를 겨누고 방아쇠를 당긴 다음, 수류탄 세 개짜리 로켓이 알아서 처리하는 걸 지켜보세요. 때로는 단순한 게 최고입니다. Clanguard 버전은 반두르 재료와 외계 유물로 개조했습니다.

Boomtube Rocket.title: Boomtube Rocket
Boomtube Rocket.subtitle: Magazine
Boomtube Rocket.lead: The Boomtube Rocket is a magazine for the Boomtube launcher, essentially three grenades strapped together as a single improvised round. Its manufacturer is Unknown .
Boomtube Rocket.desc: Made for the Boomtube launcher, this "rocket" is pretty much three grenades strapped together. Good luck!
Boomtube Rocket.lead_ko: Boomtube 발사기용 탄. 수류탄 세 개를 묶어 만든 즉석 로켓입니다.
Boomtube Rocket.desc_ko: Boomtube 발사기용으로 만든 이 '로켓'은 사실상 수류탄 세 개를 묶어 놓은 것입니다. 행운을 빕니다!

Boomtube Rocket Launcher.title: Boomtube Rocket Launcher
Boomtube Rocket Launcher.subtitle: Personal weapon
Boomtube Rocket Launcher.lead: The "Boomtube" is a scrap rocket launcher sold by Grey's Market . The "warhead" consists of three grenades strapped to a rocket, has a minimum arming distance, high "spread", and is difficult to aim.
Boomtube Rocket Launcher.desc: Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best.
Boomtube Rocket Launcher.lead_ko: Grey's Market에서 파는 고물 로켓 발사기. 로켓에 수류탄 세 개를 묶은 탄두를 쓰며, 최소 무장 거리가 있고 탄이 넓게 퍼져 조준이 어렵습니다.
Boomtube Rocket Launcher.desc_ko: 조준할 시간이 어디 있어요? 무장 거리만 확보되면 마음에 안 드는 쪽으로 Boomtube 발사기를 겨누고 방아쇠를 당긴 다음, 수류탄 세 개짜리 로켓이 알아서 처리하는 걸 지켜보세요. 때로는 단순한 게 최고입니다.

Carinite.title: Carinite
Carinite.subtitle: Mineral
Carinite.lead: Carinite is a deep-red-colored harvestable mineral found only on Aberdeen and Daymar . Carinite is a common requirement for collection missions.
Carinite.desc: A rare mineral because the extreme pressure needed for its formation is very uncommon, it is in high demand thanks to its use in advanced computer processors and other cutting-edge electronics.

head: System
Planet/ Moon
rows: Aberdeen and Daymar , caves exposed by the hathor orbital laser platforms

Carinite.lead_ko: 애버딘(Aberdeen)과 데이마(Daymar)에서만 나는 짙은 붉은색 광물. 수집 계약에서 자주 요구됩니다.
Carinite.desc_ko: 형성에 필요한 극한의 압력이 매우 드물어 희귀한 광물입니다. 첨단 컴퓨터 프로세서와 최신 전자 기기에 쓰여 수요가 높습니다.

Carinite (Pure).title: Carinite (Pure)
Carinite (Pure).subtitle: Mineral
Carinite (Pure).lead: Carinite (Pure) is a deep-red-colored harvestable mineral found only on Aberdeen and Daymar . This pure vein is more rare and valuable.
Carinite (Pure).desc: Typical carinite sources feature various impurities. However, under certain extremely rare conditions, carinite veins that are more than 90% pure can form. Computing hardware that demands exacting precision will usually seek out pure carinite.

head: System
Planet/ Moon
rows: Aberdeen and Daymar , caves exposed by the hathor orbital laser platforms (rare chance of spawning)

Carinite (Pure).lead_ko: 애버딘과 데이마에서만 나는 카리나이트의 순수 광맥. 일반 카리나이트보다 드물고 값어치가 높습니다.
Carinite (Pure).desc_ko: 보통 카리나이트는 여러 불순물을 포함합니다. 하지만 극히 드문 조건에서는 순도 90%가 넘는 광맥이 생기기도 합니다. 높은 정밀도가 필요한 컴퓨팅 장비는 주로 순수 카리나이트를 찾습니다.

Citrus Beef Burrito.title: Citrus Beef Burrito
Citrus Beef Burrito.subtitle: Food
Citrus Beef Burrito.lead: Citrus Beef Burrito is a food item with a citrus-seasoned beef filling, available as a consumable that restores a small amount of hunger.
Citrus Beef Burrito.desc: This satisfying burrito features a tortilla wrapper filled with tangy shredded beef.
Citrus Beef Burrito.lead_ko: 시트러스 양념 소고기를 넣은 부리토. 허기를 조금 회복합니다.
Citrus Beef Burrito.desc_ko: 새콤한 찢은 소고기를 토르티야에 가득 채운 든든한 부리토.

Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.title: Coda "Ascension" Pistol
Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.subtitle: Personal weapon
Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.lead: The Coda "Ascension" Pistol is a pistol manufactured by Kastak Arms . The Ascension edition of the Coda Pistol has steel and copper accents inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen .
Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.desc: Often called the Kastak Arms "hand cannon," the Coda can end an engagement with a single .50 caliber round, although the substantial power can make the Coda's recoil hard to handle. Considering its limited magazine size and substantial kick, sustained fire is discouraged in favor of more accurate single shots. Designed in honor of IAE 2953, the Ascension edition has steel and copper accents inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.
Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.lead_ko: Kastak Arms의 권총 Coda의 Ascension 에디션. Gatac Manufacture의 Syulen에서 영감을 받은 강철·구리 장식이 들어갔습니다.
Coda \"Ascension\" Pistol.desc_ko: Kastak Arms의 '핸드 캐논'이라고도 불리는 Coda는 .50구경 한 발로 교전을 끝낼 수 있지만, 위력이 큰 만큼 반동을 다루기 어렵습니다. 탄창이 작고 반동이 세서 연사보다는 정확한 단발 사격을 권합니다. IAE 2953을 기념해 디자인된 Ascension 에디션에는 Gatac Manufacture의 Syulen에서 영감을 받은 강철·구리 장식이 들어갔습니다.

Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap).title: Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap)
Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap).subtitle: Magazine
Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap).lead: The Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap) is a magazine for the Coda Pistol , holding .50 caliber rounds. It is manufactured by Kastak Arms .
Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap).desc: This magazine for the Kastak Arms Coda holds six .50 caliber rounds.
Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap).desc_ko: Kastak Arms Coda용 탄창으로, .50구경 탄 6발이 들어갑니다.

Copper.title: Copper
Copper.subtitle: Metal
Copper.lead: Copper is a metal refined from copper ore.
Copper.desc: A soft red-orange colored metal with high conductivity. Prone to oxidation unless properly treated.

Copper.desc_ko: 전도성이 높은 부드러운 적주황색 금속. 제대로 처리하지 않으면 쉽게 산화됩니다.

Corbel Arms Crush.title: Corbel Arms Crush
Corbel Arms Crush.subtitle: Arm armor
Corbel Arms Crush.lead: The Corbel Arms Crush are the heavy arms of the Corbel armor set manufactured by Clark Defense Systems .
Corbel Arms Crush.desc: Originally designed as a strength enhancement suit to give factory workers better lifting power, CDS found wider application in utilizing its defensive capabilities. It's triple-enforced armor plating provides extreme physical protection, with deliberate placing of materials to protect the most vulnerable parts of the body. A series of pneumatic levers offer increased flexibility in the joints, alleviating pressure and weight in key areas to create an accessible and highly protective armor despite its heavy weight. The Crush edition consists of a polished black metal with brushed bronze detailing.
Corbel Arms Crush.lead_ko: Clark Defense Systems의 Corbel 방어구 세트 중 중장갑 팔 (Crush 도색).
Corbel Arms Crush.desc_ko: 원래는 공장 노동자의 들어 올리는 힘을 키워 주는 근력 강화 슈트로 설계됐지만, CDS는 그 방어 능력에서 더 넓은 쓰임새를 찾았습니다. 3중 강화 장갑판이 매우 강력한 물리적 보호를 제공하고, 몸에서 가장 취약한 부위를 지키도록 재료를 배치했습니다. 공압 레버가 관절의 유연성을 높이고 핵심 부위의 압력과 무게를 덜어 줘, 무거운 무게에도 다루기 쉽고 보호력이 뛰어난 방어구가 되었습니다. Crush 에디션은 광택 나는 검은 금속에 브러시드 브론즈 장식을 더했습니다.

Council Scrip.title: Council Scrip
Council Scrip.subtitle: Currency
Council Scrip.lead: Council Scrip is a physical scrip currency issued by The Council in Star Citizen that can be traded in for items at any Wikelo Emporium station.
Council Scrip.desc: Consider this scrip your reward for a job well done. While not credits, it can be traded in to certain people for certain things.
Council Scrip.lead_ko: The Council이 발행하는 실물 스크립 화폐. 위켈로 엠포리엄에서 아이템과 교환할 수 있습니다.
Council Scrip.desc_ko: 일을 잘 해낸 보상이라고 생각하세요. 크레딧은 아니지만, 특정한 사람에게 특정한 물건과 바꿀 수 있습니다.

Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo W.title: A2 Hercules Starlifter
Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo W.subtitle: Crusader Industries
Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo W.lead: The A2 Hercules Starlifter is a military heavy gunship and bomber developed by Crusader Industries . The A2 gunship has been used to devastating effect in airborne assaults, search and rescue operations, and landing initiatives. With more than double the firepower of the M2, and a custom bomb bay capable of delivering a staggering payload, the A2 caters to anyone hauling massive amounts of cargo through potentially unfriendly skies.
Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo W.key: Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo War Special
Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo W.lead_ko: Crusader Industries의 군용 중형 건쉽·폭격기. 공중 강습, 수색 구조, 상륙 작전에서 큰 위력을 발휘합니다. 위켈로 'War Special' 버전.
Crusader A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo W.ko_name: 크루세이더 A2 헤라클레스 스타리프터 위켈로 전쟁 스페셜

Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikel.title: Ares Star Fighter Inferno
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikel.subtitle: Crusader Industries
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikel.lead: The Ares Star Fighter Inferno , produced by Crusader Industries , is an anti-capital fighter equipped with a Behring manufactured Size 7 ballistic gatling. Its sustained fire capability is devastating, overpowering adversaries with a relentless barrage that can take down smaller vessels and rapidly shred the hulls of larger ones. While formidable on its own, the Inferno is an effective complement to the Ares Ion in capital ship engagements, as its armor-piercing rounds can be paired with the Ion's shield-disabling shots. This combination enhances the Inferno's effectiveness in hunting down capital ships.
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikel.key: Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikelo War Special
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikel.lead_ko: Crusader Industries의 대(對)주력함 전투기. Behring 7사이즈 탄도 개틀링으로 엄청난 지속 화력을 냅니다. 위켈로 'War Special' 버전.
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikel.ko_name: 크루세이더 아레스 스타파이터 인페르노 위켈로 워 스페셜

Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sn.title: Ares Star Fighter Ion
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sn.subtitle: Crusader Industries
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sn.lead: The Ares Star Fighter Ion is an anti-capital fighter manufactured by Crusader Industries . Designed to lead the charge against capital ships and heavily armed flotillas, the Ares ION excels at spearheading a fleet of fighters and support ships. Its purpose-built Behring SF7E laser cannon accurately delivers high-powered shots to quickly disable the shields of gunships and, with the support of other Ares variants, efficiently incapacitate capital-class vessels.
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sn.key: Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sneak Special
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sn.lead_ko: Crusader Industries의 대주력함 전투기. 주력함과 중무장 함대를 상대로 돌격을 이끄는 데 특화돼 있습니다. 위켈로 'Sneak Special' 버전.
Crusader Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sn.ko_name: 크루세이더 아레스 스타파이터 이온 위켈로 스니크 스페셜

Crusader C1 Spirit Wikelo Special.title: C1 Spirit
Crusader C1 Spirit Wikelo Special.subtitle: Crusader Industries
Crusader C1 Spirit Wikelo Special.lead: The C1 Spirit is a medium-size hauler developed by Crusader Industries . It serves as an essential logistical asset for any operation, facilitating the transportation of critical supplies and the delivery of ground exploration vehicles. Its spacious cargo capacity, combined with the renowned Crusader design, positions it as the optimal choice for pilots aiming to transport substantial loads while maintaining ease of use. Featuring an ample cargo hold and a rail-mounted tractor beam, the C1 Spirit serves as a versatile and adaptable vessel for Citizens navigating the 'verse on a regular basis.

Crusader Intrepid Wikelo Work Special.title: Intrepid
Crusader Intrepid Wikelo Work Special.subtitle: Crusader Industries
Crusader Intrepid Wikelo Work Special.lead: The Intrepid is a small starter ship developed by Crusader Industries . Designed for those who are ready to embrace the future, this innovative ship is equipped to handle a variety of tasks and overcome diverse challenges. With its spacious cargo area and comfortable living accommodations, the Intrepid ensures that your solo adventures among the stars are both productive and enjoyable.
Crusader Intrepid Wikelo Work Special.lead_ko: Crusader Industries의 소형 입문용 함선. 다양한 임무를 소화하도록 설계됐습니다. 위켈로 'Work Special' 버전.

DCHS-05 Orbital Positioning Comp-Board.lead: The DCHS-05 Orbital Positioning Comp-Board is a Comp-Board used as Board 5 in PYAM-EXHANG-0-1 , and is also required for some Wikelo collection contracts.
DCHS-05 Orbital Positioning Comp-Board.desc: This discrete core hangar system comp-board is coded with orbital positioning operations.
DCHS-05 Orbital Positioning Comp-Board.lead_ko: PYAM-EXHANG-0-1에서 5번 보드로 쓰이는 컴프 보드. 일부 위켈로 수집 계약에도 필요합니다.
DCHS-05 Orbital Positioning Comp-Board.desc_ko: 궤도 위치 작업이 코딩된 개별 코어 격납고 시스템 컴프 보드.

Demeco \"Red Alert\" LMG.title: Demeco "Red Alert" LMG
Demeco \"Red Alert\" LMG.subtitle: Personal weapon
Demeco \"Red Alert\" LMG.lead: The Demeco "Red Alert" LMG is a lmg manufactured by Klaus & Werner .
Demeco \"Red Alert\" LMG.desc: Klaus & Werner has created an iconic weapon with tried and true Demeco laser LMG. Used extensively in military engagements, this short-to-mid-range infantry favorite has been constructed with stability and accuracy at the forefront. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.
Demeco \"Red Alert\" LMG.lead_ko: Klaus & Werner의 경기관총 Demeco (Red Alert 에디션).
Demeco \"Red Alert\" LMG.desc_ko: Klaus & Werner는 검증된 Demeco 레이저 경기관총으로 상징적인 무기를 만들었습니다. 군사 작전에서 널리 쓰이는 이 근·중거리 보병용 인기 무기는 안정성과 정확도를 최우선으로 제작됐습니다. 'Red Alert' 에디션은 회색과 강렬한 빨강을 섞어 대담하고 역동적인 디자인을 완성했습니다.

Demeco LMG Battery (100 cap).title: Demeco LMG Battery (100 cap)
Demeco LMG Battery (100 cap).subtitle: Magazine
Demeco LMG Battery (100 cap).lead: The Demeco LMG Battery (100 cap) is a magazine for the Demeco LMG , serving as a replacement battery for Klaus & Werner's iconic light machine gun. It is manufactured by Klaus & Werner .
Demeco LMG Battery (100 cap).desc: This is a replacement battery for Klaus & Werner's iconic light machine gun, the Demeco.
Demeco LMG Battery (100 cap).lead_ko: Klaus & Werner Demeco 경기관총용 교체 배터리.
Demeco LMG Battery (100 cap).desc_ko: Klaus & Werner의 상징적인 경기관총 Demeco용 교체 배터리.

Drake Clipper Wikelo War Special.title: Clipper
Drake Clipper Wikelo War Special.subtitle: Drake Interplanetary
Drake Clipper Wikelo War Special.lead: The Clipper is a multi-functional ship developed by Drake Interplanetary . This vessel is engineered for versatility and multiple functions. Equipped with a cargo bay, medical facilities, and crafting capabilities, the Clipper serves as an ideal all-rounder for any emerging spacefaring venture.

Drake Golem Wikelo Work Special.title: Golem
Drake Golem Wikelo Work Special.subtitle: Drake Interplanetary
Drake Golem Wikelo Work Special.lead: The Golem is a small entry level mining ship developed by Drake Interplanetary . It is an exemplary vessel tailored for individuals aspiring to embark on a mining career. This ship is equipped with a custom mining laser and has the ability to transport 32 SCU of precious materials in two proprietary 16 SCU Containers . True to Drake's design philosophy, the Golem is a specialized craft that emphasizes practicality over unnecessary embellishments.

Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream.title: Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream
Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream.subtitle: Food
Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream.lead: Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream is a fat-free food product made by Ermer Family Farms, serving as a lighter take on their ice cream line and restoring the player's hunger when consumed.
Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream.desc: This premium 100% fat free, real dairy ice cream blended with natural vanilla is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.
Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream.key: Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream
Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream.lead_ko: Ermer Family Farms의 무지방 아이스크림. 먹으면 허기가 회복됩니다.
Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream.desc_ko: 천연 바닐라를 넣은 무지방 100% 진짜 유제품 아이스크림. Ermer Family Farms의 숙련된 장인들이 손수 만듭니다.

Esperia Prowler Utility Wikelo Work Spec.title: Prowler Utility
Esperia Prowler Utility Wikelo Work Spec.subtitle: Esperia
Esperia Prowler Utility Wikelo Work Spec.lead: The Prowler Utility is medium sized cargo variant of the Prowler series of spacecraft, developed by Esperia . Originally designed to support Tevarin military operations directly on the frontlines, it is outfitted with a tractor beam that facilitates the effective handling of cargo to its easily reachable hold. Furthermore, due to the ship's stealth capabilities, the Utility functions as an ideal transport for various discreet cargo operations.

Expired Quantanium Fuel Canister.title: Expired Quantanium Fuel Canister
Expired Quantanium Fuel Canister.subtitle: Cargo
Expired Quantanium Fuel Canister.lead: This container from the QV Extraction Facility's operational days contains quantanium fuel that has been improperly stored causing a chemical anomaly in the fuel.
Expired Quantanium Fuel Canister.desc: This container from the QV Extraction Facility's operational days contains quantanium fuel that has been improperly stored causing a chemical anomaly in the fuel.
Expired Quantanium Fuel Canister.lead_ko: QV 추출 시설이 운영되던 시절의 연료 용기. 잘못 보관된 퀀타늄 연료가 화학적 이상을 일으킨 상태입니다.
Expired Quantanium Fuel Canister.desc_ko: QV 추출 시설이 운영되던 시절의 용기입니다. 잘못 보관된 퀀타늄 연료가 화학적 이상을 일으킨 상태로 들어 있습니다.

Fresnel \"Deepwater\" Energy LMG.title: Fresnel "Deepwater" Energy LMG
Fresnel \"Deepwater\" Energy LMG.subtitle: Personal weapon
Fresnel \"Deepwater\" Energy LMG.lead: The Fresnel "Deepwater" Energy LMG is a stocked weapon manufactured by Verified Offworld Laser Technologies .
Fresnel \"Deepwater\" Energy LMG.desc: The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management. The Deepwater edition combines a weathered blue with profound black features.
Fresnel \"Deepwater\" Energy LMG.desc_ko: VOLT 엔지니어들은 빠르게 쏟아지는 치명적인 사격으로 전투를 시작할 수 있는 강력한 에너지 무기를 최전선에 보내려고 Fresnel 경기관총을 만들었습니다. 총이 달아오를수록 탄은 느려지지만 더 강력해지니 과열에 주의하세요. 이만한 무기에는 단단한 자세가 필요해서, 반동을 잘 다루려면 앉은 자세로 사격하는 것을 권합니다. Deepwater 에디션은 바랜 파란색과 깊은 검정을 조합했습니다.

Fresnel \"Yormandi\" Energy LMG.title: Fresnel "Yormandi" Energy LMG
Fresnel \"Yormandi\" Energy LMG.subtitle: Personal weapon
Fresnel \"Yormandi\" Energy LMG.lead: The Fresnel "Yormandi" LMG is a stocked weapon manufactured by Verified Offworld Laser Technologies .
Fresnel \"Yormandi\" Energy LMG.desc: The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management. The Yormandi edition is mottled green with a graphic of the fierce reptile along the side.
Fresnel \"Yormandi\" Energy LMG.desc_ko: VOLT 엔지니어들은 빠르게 쏟아지는 치명적인 사격으로 전투를 시작할 수 있는 강력한 에너지 무기를 최전선에 보내려고 Fresnel 경기관총을 만들었습니다. 총이 달아오를수록 탄은 느려지지만 더 강력해지니 과열에 주의하세요. 이만한 무기에는 단단한 자세가 필요해서, 반동을 잘 다루려면 앉은 자세로 사격하는 것을 권합니다. Yormandi 에디션은 얼룩덜룩한 초록색에 옆면을 따라 사나운 파충류 그림이 그려져 있습니다.

Fresnel Energy LMG.title: Fresnel Energy LMG
Fresnel Energy LMG.subtitle: Personal weapon
Fresnel Energy LMG.lead: The Fresnel Energy LMG is a light machine gun manufactured by Verified Offworld Laser Technologies . This heavy-hitter ramps up the punishment as it heats up, trading rate of fire for raw stopping power. As it nears peak overheat, it unleashes searing energy blasts capable of tearing through hostile forces with terrifying efficiency. Featuring a hefty reload time but with a high capacity magazine.
Fresnel Energy LMG.desc: The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management.
Fresnel Energy LMG.lead_ko: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies(VOLT)의 경기관총. 열이 오를수록 위력이 세지는 대신 연사력이 줄어듭니다.
Fresnel Energy LMG.desc_ko: VOLT 엔지니어들은 빠르게 쏟아지는 치명적인 사격으로 전투를 시작할 수 있는 강력한 에너지 무기를 최전선에 보내려고 Fresnel 경기관총을 만들었습니다. 총이 달아오를수록 탄은 느려지지만 더 강력해지니 과열에 주의하세요. 이만한 무기에는 단단한 자세가 필요해서, 반동을 잘 다루려면 앉은 자세로 사격하는 것을 권합니다.

Gallant \"Red Alert\" Rifle.title: Gallant "Red Alert" Rifle
Gallant \"Red Alert\" Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
Gallant \"Red Alert\" Rifle.lead: The Gallant "Red Alert" Rifle is an assault rifle manufactured by Klaus & Werner .
Gallant \"Red Alert\" Rifle.desc: Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.
Gallant \"Red Alert\" Rifle.lead_ko: Klaus & Werner의 돌격소총 Gallant (Red Alert 에디션).
Gallant \"Red Alert\" Rifle.desc_ko: 믿을 수 있는 돌격 무기는 유행을 타지 않습니다. Klaus & Werner는 그 전통을 이어 Gallant를 선보였습니다. 이 에너지 돌격소총은 중거리까지 정확하고 지속적인 사격이 가능하며, 대용량 전력 시스템 덕분에 배터리 하나로 훨씬 많이 쏠 수 있습니다. 'Red Alert' 에디션은 회색과 강렬한 빨강을 섞어 대담하고 역동적인 디자인을 완성했습니다.

Gallant Rifle Battery (45 cap).title: Gallant Rifle Battery (45 cap)
Gallant Rifle Battery (45 cap).subtitle: Magazine
Gallant Rifle Battery (45 cap).lead: The Gallant Rifle Battery (45 cap) is a high-capacity magazine manufactured by Klaus & Werner that powers the company's Gallant energy rifle.
Gallant Rifle Battery (45 cap).desc: This high-capacity battery sets itself apart by powering the Klaus & Werner Gallant energy rifle for 45 shots per charge.
Gallant Rifle Battery (45 cap).lead_ko: Klaus & Werner Gallant 에너지 소총용 대용량 배터리.
Gallant Rifle Battery (45 cap).desc_ko: 충전 한 번에 Klaus & Werner Gallant 에너지 소총을 45발 쏠 수 있게 해 주는 대용량 배터리.

Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition.title: Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition
Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition.subtitle: Arm armor
Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition.lead: The Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition is the arms armor of the Geist armor set, manufactured by Kilgore and Poole .
Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition.desc: An ideal synthesis of strength and technology, the Geist Stealth Armor has been crafted from military-grade carbon silk sourced from the same manufacturers that protect the UEE's special forces. Hair-thin filaments woven into the fabric mask the wearer's emissions, making them undetectable via radar, and specialized tubing built into the soles of the boots dampens the sound of footsteps. The ASD Edition features a hooded cloak printed with a dark urban camo pattern alongside ASD's signature logo.
Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition.lead_ko: Kilgore and Poole의 Geist 방어구 세트 중 팔 부위 (ASD 에디션).
Geist Armor Arms ASD Edition.desc_ko: 힘과 기술이 이상적으로 결합된 Geist 스텔스 방어구는 UEE 특수부대를 보호하는 제조사에서 공급받은 군용 카본 실크로 만들었습니다. 원단에 짜 넣은 머리카락 굵기의 필라멘트가 착용자의 방출 신호를 가려 레이더에 잡히지 않게 하고, 부츠 밑창의 특수 관이 발소리를 줄여 줍니다. ASD 에디션은 어두운 도시 위장 무늬가 프린트된 후드 망토와 ASD 로고를 갖췄습니다.

Geist Armor Arms Snow Camo.title: Geist Armor Arms Snow Camo
Geist Armor Arms Snow Camo.subtitle: Arm armor
Geist Armor Arms Snow Camo.lead: The Geist Armor Arms Snow Camo is the Snow Camo variant of the arms of the Geist Armor set, manufactured by Kilgore and Poole .
Geist Armor Arms Snow Camo.desc: An ideal synthesis of strength and technology, the Geist Stealth Armor has been crafted from military-grade carbon silk sourced from the same manufacturers that protect the UEE's special forces. Hair-thin filaments woven into the fabric mask the wearer's emissions, making them undetectable via radar, and specialized tubing built into the soles of the boots dampens the sound of footsteps. Featuring a hooded shawl and a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.

Government Cartography Agency Medal (Pri.subtitle: Misc item
Government Cartography Agency Medal (Pri.lead: The Government Cartography Agency Medal (Pristine) is a medal awarded to members of the Government Cartography Agency , shown here in pristine condition. The medals can be recovered from the bodies of ace pilots that appear during patrol mercenary contracts .
Government Cartography Agency Medal (Pri.desc: This medal was awarded by United Planets of Earth (UPE) to members of the Government Cartography Agency who flew or supported missions involving the discovery, exploration, or scanning of new systems. It features a star woven with one large and three smaller interlocking circles that was the central symbol on the UPE flag. The exquisite state of the ribbon and metal has left this one in pristine condition.
Government Cartography Agency Medal (Pri.lead_ko: 정부 지도제작국(GCA) 대원에게 수여된 메달로, 손상 없는 상태(Pristine)입니다. 시체에서 회수할 수 있습니다.
Government Cartography Agency Medal (Pri.desc_ko: 지구 연합 행성(UPE)이 새로운 성계의 발견·탐사·스캔 임무를 수행하거나 지원한 정부 지도제작국 대원에게 수여한 메달입니다. UPE 국기의 중심 문양이던, 큰 원 하나와 작은 원 세 개가 맞물린 별 무늬가 새겨져 있습니다. 리본과 금속 상태가 훌륭해 손상 없는 상태로 남아 있습니다.

Irradiated Kopion Horn.title: Irradiated Kopion Horn
Irradiated Kopion Horn.subtitle: Misc item
Irradiated Kopion Horn.lead: The Irradiated Kopion Horn is a horn collected from an Irradiated Kopion .
Irradiated Kopion Horn.desc: The horn of the kopion is made of a unique combination of bone and naturally-occurring carbon nanomaterials. When properly processed, it can be used to aid in bone regeneration with a far greater rate of success than lab-grown materials. This application has made it a valuable commodity.
Irradiated Kopion Horn.lead_ko: 방사능에 오염된 코피온(Irradiated Kopion)에게서 얻는 뿔.
Irradiated Kopion Horn.desc_ko: 코피온의 뿔은 뼈와 천연 탄소 나노물질이 독특하게 결합된 것입니다. 제대로 가공하면 실험실에서 기른 재료보다 훨씬 높은 성공률로 뼈 재생을 도울 수 있어, 귀한 원자재로 취급됩니다.

Irradiated Valakkar Fang (Adult).title: Irradiated Valakkar Fang (Adult)
Irradiated Valakkar Fang (Adult).subtitle: Misc item
Irradiated Valakkar Fang (Adult).lead: The Irradiated Valakkar Fang (Adult) is a fang from an adult Irradiated Valakkar .
Irradiated Valakkar Fang (Adult).desc: The valakkar continually sheds its teeth throughout its lifetime. As the animal burrows through the sand and catches prey, its teeth are frequently damaged. Once a new tooth finishes forming, it severs the connective tissue that was holding the old tooth in place, causing it to break off and fall to the ground. The fangs of the valakkar can also be extracted from the animal's mouth after its death. This fang was exposed to radiation over a long period of time and has developed unusual coloration.
Irradiated Valakkar Fang (Adult).desc_ko: 발라카는 평생 이빨이 계속 빠지고 새로 납니다. 모래 속을 파고들며 먹이를 잡는 동안 이빨이 자주 상하기 때문이죠. 새 이빨이 다 자라면 옛 이빨을 붙잡던 결합 조직이 끊어져 땅에 떨어집니다. 발라카가 죽은 뒤 입에서 뽑아낼 수도 있습니다. 이 송곳니는 오랫동안 방사능에 노출되어 특이한 색을 띠게 되었습니다.

Irradiated Valakkar Fang (Apex).subtitle: Misc item

Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).title: Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA)
Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).subtitle: Misc item
Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).lead: The Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA) is a pearl from an Irradiated Valakkar .
Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).desc: The valakkar pearl is harvested from the skin of the valakkar. As the valakkar moves through its environment, a large piece of grit will sometimes penetrate its thick hide. If the grit is unable to be expelled on its own, the valakkar's skin will grow to encase it. Layers of organic matter will then coat the piece of grit, isolating it from the valakkar's vulnerable dermis, thus ensuring that it will not cause infection. These "pearls" can become substantial in size over time. Because the valakkar that grew this pearl was exposed to radiation over a long period of time, it has developed unusual properties.
Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).lead_ko: 방사능에 오염된 발라카에게서 얻는 진주 (AA 등급).
Irradiated Valakkar Pearl (Grade AA).desc_ko: 발라카 진주는 발라카의 피부에서 얻습니다. 발라카가 돌아다니다 보면 큰 모래알이 두꺼운 가죽을 뚫고 들어가기도 하는데, 스스로 빼내지 못하면 피부가 자라 그것을 감쌉니다. 그 위로 유기물이 층층이 쌓여 연약한 진피와 격리되므로 감염이 일어나지 않습니다. 이 '진주'는 시간이 지나며 꽤 커질 수 있습니다. 이 진주를 키운 발라카는 오랫동안 방사능에 노출되어, 진주도 특이한 성질을 띠게 되었습니다.

Jaclium (Ore).title: Jaclium (Ore)
Jaclium (Ore).subtitle: Unrefined ores
Jaclium (Ore).lead: Jaclium (Ore) is a rare metal ore, a naturally occurring form of jahlium used to produce extremely strong, high-tensile alloys.
Jaclium (Ore).desc: A naturally occurring rare metal form of jahlium, it is used in the production of extremely strong alloys with incredible tensile strength. Originally confused with common jahlium when first discovered, the above average results when used lead to researchers to realize its value.
Jaclium (Ore).lead_ko: 희귀 금속 광석. 아주 강하고 인장력 높은 합금을 만드는 데 쓰입니다.
Jaclium (Ore).desc_ko: 자연적으로 생기는 희귀한 금속 형태의 잘리움으로, 인장 강도가 엄청난 초강력 합금을 만드는 데 쓰입니다. 처음 발견됐을 때는 일반 잘리움으로 오해받았지만, 써 보니 평균 이상의 결과가 나와 연구자들이 그 가치를 알아보게 되었습니다.

Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.title: Karna "Ascension" Rifle
Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.lead: The Karna "Ascension" Rifle is an assault rifle manufactured by Kastak Arms . The Ascension edition of the Karna rifle has steel and copper accents inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen .
Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.desc: The Karna is a classic Kastak Arms plasma assault rifle. This mid-range mauler features charged and full-auto fire modes to allow for quick and easy situational adjustments. Besides its renowned firepower, the Karna's rugged looks and reliability have made it one of Kastak Arms' most popular weapons. Designed in honor of IAE 2953, the Ascension edition has steel and copper accents inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.
Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.lead_ko: Kastak Arms의 돌격소총 Karna의 Ascension 에디션. Gatac Manufacture의 Syulen에서 영감을 받은 강철·구리 장식이 들어갔습니다.
Karna \"Ascension\" Rifle.desc_ko: Karna는 Kastak Arms의 대표적인 플라즈마 돌격소총입니다. 중거리에서 위력을 발휘하며, 충전 사격과 완전 자동 사격 모드로 상황에 맞게 빠르게 전환할 수 있습니다. 이름난 화력에 더해 투박한 외형과 신뢰성 덕분에 Kastak Arms에서 가장 인기 있는 무기 중 하나입니다. IAE 2953을 기념해 디자인된 Ascension 에디션에는 Gatac Manufacture의 Syulen에서 영감을 받은 강철·구리 장식이 들어갔습니다.

Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).title: Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap)
Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).subtitle: Magazine

Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).desc: This is a replacement battery for Kastak Arms' plasma assault rifle, the Karna.
Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).lead_ko: Kastak Arms Karna 플라즈마 돌격소총용 교체 탄창.
Karna Rifle Battery (35 cap).desc_ko: Kastak Arms 플라즈마 돌격소총 Karna용 교체 배터리.

Killshot \"Dominion Camo\" Rifle.title: Killshot "Dominion Camo" Rifle
Killshot \"Dominion Camo\" Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
Killshot \"Dominion Camo\" Rifle.lead: The Killshot "Dominion Camo" Rifle is an assault rifle .
Killshot \"Dominion Camo\" Rifle.desc: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, and if you aim just right, so will a round from the Killshot assault rifle. What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm. The Dominion Camo edition adds a dark green camo pattern to the rifle.
Killshot \"Dominion Camo\" Rifle.desc_ko: 아름다움은 보는 사람 눈에 달렸고, 제대로 겨누면 Killshot 돌격소총의 탄도 그 눈에 박힐 겁니다. 우아함은 부족해도 이 클래식한 디자인엔 거친 매력이 있습니다. Dominion Camo 에디션은 소총에 짙은 초록 위장 무늬를 더했습니다.

Killshot Rifle.title: Killshot Rifle
Killshot Rifle.subtitle: Personal weapon
Killshot Rifle.lead: The Killshot Rifle is a twin ballistic-energy linked weapon sold by Grey's Market . The rifle fires in alternating ballistic and energy projectiles.
Killshot Rifle.desc: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, and if you aim just right, so will a round from the Killshot assault rifle. What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm.
Killshot Rifle.lead_ko: Grey's Market에서 파는 탄도·에너지 연동 쌍열 소총. 탄도탄과 에너지탄을 번갈아 발사합니다.
Killshot Rifle.desc_ko: 아름다움은 보는 사람 눈에 달렸고, 제대로 겨누면 Killshot 돌격소총의 탄도 그 눈에 박힐 겁니다. 우아함은 부족해도 이 클래식한 디자인엔 거친 매력이 있습니다.

Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap).subtitle: Magazine

Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap).desc: This magazine for the Killshot rifle comes pre-loaded with forty-five rounds.
Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap).desc_ko: Killshot 소총용 탄창으로, 45발이 장전된 상태로 제공됩니다.

Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special.title: L-21 Wolf
Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special.subtitle: Kruger Intergalactic
Kruger L-21 Wolf Wikelo Sneak Special.lead: The L-21 Wolf is a small light Fighter developed by Kruger Intergalactic . It illustrates a combination of swiftness, grace, and an extraordinarily precise design. This vessel not only represents Kruger's inaugural independently produced ship and showcases their expertise, but it is also thoroughly outfitted for warfare, able to function autonomously or in coordination with others, armed with an impressive array of armaments.

Merging speed, elegance, and an exceptionally accurate design, the Alpha Wolf serves as a demonstration for Kruger while also being fully equipped for combat, capable of hunting solo or in groups with a formidable selection of weaponry.

Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).subtitle: Misc item
Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).lead: The Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine) is a tradable item found within the Warehouse section of the QV Station in Nyx .
Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).desc: A large artifact fragment of unknown origin and made of an unidentified material. Though broken, it's otherwise considered in pristine condition. The fragment features intricate etchings that subtly glow green and is overlaid with gold-colored metallic banding.
Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).lead_ko: 닉스(Nyx) QV 스테이션의 창고 구역에서 찾을 수 있는 거래 가능한 유물 조각 (손상 없는 상태).
Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine).desc_ko: 출처를 알 수 없고 정체불명의 재질로 된 큰 유물 조각. 부서지긴 했지만 상태는 손상 없는 것으로 봅니다. 은은하게 초록빛을 내는 정교한 조각이 새겨져 있고, 금색 금속 띠가 둘러져 있습니다.

MG Scrip.title: MG Scrip
MG Scrip.subtitle: Currency
MG Scrip.lead: MG Scrip is a scrip currency in Star Citizen awarded by the Mercenary Guild for completing their contracts. MG Scrip can be traded for Wikelo Favors , which can in turn be traded for items at any Wikelo Emporium station.
MG Scrip.desc: Issued by the Mercenary Guild, this scrip guarantees the bearer goods in trade at authorized locations as outlined in the guild's bylaws and statutes 202C-05A. Not legal tender.
MG Scrip.lead_ko: 용병 길드(Mercenary Guild) 계약을 완료하면 받는 스크립 화폐. 위켈로 호의(Wikelo Favor)로 바꿀 수 있습니다.
MG Scrip.desc_ko: 용병 길드가 발행한 스크립으로, 길드 규약 202C-05A에 정한 공인 장소에서 소지자에게 물품 교환을 보장합니다. 법정 화폐가 아닙니다.

MISC Fortune Wikelo Special.title: Fortune
MISC Fortune Wikelo Special.subtitle: Musashi Industrial and Starflight Concern
MISC Fortune Wikelo Special.lead: The Fortune is a salvage ship developed by Musashi Industrial and Starflight Concern . It represents a significant advancement in industrial operations, offering a streamlined and efficient vessel tailored for salvage operations. Designed for individual operators, this innovative ship features a groundbreaking external cargo loader that simplifies the salvaging process for solo crews. It is the ideal choice for those seeking to enhance their operational capabilities.

MISC Prospector Wikelo Work Special.title: Prospector
MISC Prospector Wikelo Work Special.subtitle: Musashi Industrial and Starflight Concern
MISC Prospector Wikelo Work Special.lead: The Prospector is a small sized mining ship developed by Musashi Industrial and Starflight Concern . Designed as a single person operated vessel, it features a telescopic mining arm with interchangeable lasers, with 4 detachable collapsible ore storage containers and comfortable living quarters.

MISC Prospector Wikelo Work Special.lead_ko: MISC의 소형 1인 채굴선. 교체 가능한 레이저가 달린 신축식 채굴 팔과 분리식 컨테이너 4개를 갖췄습니다. 위켈로 'Work Special' 버전.

MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special.title: Starlancer MAX
MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special.subtitle: Musashi Industrial and Starflight Concern
MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special.lead: The Starlancer MAX is a medium freighter developed by Musashi Industrial and Starflight Concern . It is designed specifically for deep space operations and features two cargo holds. This vessel enables freelance operators and commercial enterprises to explore further into the 'verse, pushing beyond established boundaries to support the expansion of Humanity's frontiers.
MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special.key: MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special
MISC Starlancer MAX Wikelo Work Special.lead_ko: MISC의 중형 화물선. 심우주 작전용으로 설계됐고 화물칸이 두 곳입니다. 위켈로 'Work Special' 버전.

Metamaterial Test.title: Metamaterial Test
Metamaterial Test.subtitle: Misc item
Metamaterial Test.lead: Metamaterial Test #146 is a craftable item used in Wikelo contracts, specifically the L-22 Alpha Wolf .
Metamaterial Test.desc: This is a test for new metamaterial with special design by Wikelo. It will be light and strong but maybe not! Good to test.
Metamaterial Test.lead_ko: 위켈로 계약(특히 L-22 Alpha Wolf)에 쓰이는 제작 아이템 Metamaterial Test #146.
Metamaterial Test.desc_ko: 위켈로 특별 설계 새 메타물질 시험. 가볍고 튼튼할 것, 아닐 수도! 시험하기 좋음.

Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.title: Guardian MX
Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.subtitle: Mirai
Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.lead: The Guardian MX is a variant of the Guardian heavy fighter series of ships developed by Mirai . By enhancing the Guardian fighter framework with a broader array of offensive capabilities, the MX is equipped with increased firepower and armor, making it well-suited for overpowering adversaries. Although it lacks the agility of the original Guardian, this heavy fighter still demonstrates greater maneuverability compared to numerous other vessels within its category.
Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.key: Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special
Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.lead_ko: Mirai Guardian 중전투기 계열의 화력 강화형 MX. 위켈로 'War Special' 버전.
Mirai Guardian MX Wikelo War Special.ko_name: 미라이 가디언 MX 위켈로 워 스페셜

Mirai Guardian QI Wikelo Special.title: Guardian QI
Mirai Guardian QI Wikelo Special.subtitle: Mirai
Mirai Guardian QI Wikelo Special.lead: The Guardian QI is an interdictor variant of the Guardian manufactured by Mirai . The Guardian exemplifies resilience and proficiency in combat scenarios, demonstrating exceptional capability even when confronting adversaries of significantly larger size. The QI enhances this effectiveness by incorporating a quantum dampener, which mitigates the advantage of faster vessels, thereby leveling the playing field against more agile opponents. This feature equips the Guardian to be well-prepared for a diverse range of missions.
Mirai Guardian QI Wikelo Special.lead_ko: Mirai Guardian의 차단(인터딕터)형 QI. 위켈로 'Special' 버전.

Mirai Guardian Wikelo War Special.title: Guardian
Mirai Guardian Wikelo War Special.subtitle: Mirai
Mirai Guardian Wikelo War Special.lead: The Guardian is a small Heavy Fighter developed by Mirai . Following its success in the snub market with the highly specialized Fury , Mirai expands its ambitions by entering the heavyweight space-combat arena. The Guardian exemplifies Mirai's commitment to performance-driven ship design, amplifying this philosophy to create a formidable brawler. This vessel is engineered to confront a wide array of threats, regardless of their scale or intensity.
Mirai Guardian Wikelo War Special.lead_ko: Mirai의 소형 중전투기. 스넙 전투기 Fury의 성공 뒤 Mirai가 중량급 우주전에 내놓은 기체입니다. 위켈로 'War Special' 버전.

Mirai Pulse Wikelo Special.title: Pulse
Mirai Pulse Wikelo Special.subtitle: Mirai
Mirai Pulse Wikelo Special.lead: The Pulse is a compact grav-cycle by Mirai . An open-canopy bike with a form-fitting silhouette and an intelligent integrated combat system, the Mirai Pulse is a fast, nimble vehicle for all planetary needs. The standard version showcases exceptional combat capabilities. Equipped with a Size 2 laser repeater mounted on the nose from the factory, engaging enemies directly has never been more thrilling. Performing jousting, hit-and-run, or bank-and-flank tactics is now more effortless than in the past.
Mirai Pulse Wikelo Special.lead_ko: Mirai의 소형 그래브 사이클(호버 바이크). 개방형 캐노피와 지능형 통합 전투 시스템을 갖춘 빠르고 날렵한 지상 이동 수단입니다. 위켈로 'Special' 버전.

Monde Arms.title: Monde Arms
Monde Arms.subtitle: Arm armor
Monde Arms.lead: The Monde Arms is the arms of the Monde armor set, manufactured by Kilgore and Poole .
Monde Arms.desc: From the masterwork designers of Kilgore & Poole comes the Monde heavy armor. Effortlessly integrating triple-laminate plating with the latest in defensive technology, this armor provides battle-ready protection with a next-class comfort system and specialized flex-point joints.
Monde Arms.lead_ko: Kilgore and Poole의 Monde 방어구 세트 중 팔 부위.
Monde Arms.desc_ko: Kilgore & Poole의 장인 디자이너들이 만든 Monde 중장갑 방어구. 3중 적층 장갑판과 최신 방어 기술을 매끄럽게 결합해, 차세대 착용감 시스템과 특수 유연 관절로 전투에 바로 나설 수 있는 보호력을 제공합니다.

NN-13 Cannon.title: NN-13 Cannon
NN-13 Cannon.subtitle: Gun
NN-13 Cannon.lead: The NN-13 Cannon is a MaxOx size 1 neutron cannon for vehicles, part of the N-series.
NN-13 Cannon.desc: MaxOx's NN-13 neutron cannon offers a massive energy payload at the expense of speed and energy efficiency. One could argue the virtues of speed, rate of fire and distance over damage, but the argument becomes irrelevant if you only need to hit them once.
NN-13 Cannon.desc_ko: MaxOx의 NN-13 중성자 캐논은 속도와 에너지 효율을 포기하는 대신 엄청난 에너지 위력을 냅니다. 피해량보다 속도·연사력·사거리가 낫다고 주장할 수도 있겠지만, 한 방만 맞히면 되는 상황이라면 그런 논쟁은 의미가 없습니다.

Novikov Backpack Crush.title: Novikov Backpack Crush
Novikov Backpack Crush.subtitle: Backpack
Novikov Backpack Crush.lead: The Novikov Backpack Crush is a backpack manufactured by Caldera .
Novikov Backpack Crush.desc: Confidently explore cold environments while wearing the Novikov. Caldera designed a spacious backpack to compliment this advanced exploration suit, so those venturing across unknown terrain can bring enough supplies to survive the journey. The Crush edition consists of a polished black metal with brushed bronze detailing.
Novikov Backpack Crush.desc_ko: Novikov를 입고 추운 환경을 자신 있게 탐험하세요. Caldera는 이 첨단 탐사 슈트와 짝을 이루는 넉넉한 배낭을 설계해, 미지의 지형을 건너는 이들이 여정을 버틸 만큼 충분한 보급품을 챙길 수 있게 했습니다. Crush 에디션은 광택 나는 검은 금속에 브러시드 브론즈 장식을 더했습니다.

Novikov Backpack Mire.title: Novikov Backpack Mire
Novikov Backpack Mire.subtitle: Backpack
Novikov Backpack Mire.lead: The Novikov Backpack Mire is a backpack manufactured by Clark Defense Systems .
Novikov Backpack Mire.desc: Confidently explore cold environments while wearing the Novikov. Caldera designed a spacious backpack to compliment this advanced exploration suit, so those venturing across unknown terrain can bring enough supplies to survive the journey. The Mire edition features natural greens and industrial grays.
Novikov Backpack Mire.desc_ko: Novikov를 입고 추운 환경을 자신 있게 탐험하세요. Caldera는 이 첨단 탐사 슈트와 짝을 이루는 넉넉한 배낭을 설계해, 미지의 지형을 건너는 이들이 여정을 버틸 만큼 충분한 보급품을 챙길 수 있게 했습니다. Mire 에디션은 자연스러운 초록과 산업적인 회색을 담았습니다.

P8-SC \"Red Alert\" SMG.title: P8-SC "Red Alert" SMG
P8-SC \"Red Alert\" SMG.subtitle: Personal weapon
P8-SC \"Red Alert\" SMG.lead: The P8-SC "Red Alert" SMG is a smg manufactured by Behring Applied Technology .
P8-SC \"Red Alert\" SMG.desc: When the top fighting force in the universe chooses a weapon as their standard, it pays to stand up and take notice. The Behring-crafted P8-SC has been the ballistic submachine gun of choice for the UEE Marines since it first came off the production line, but since then, many have come to rely on this weapon for their own personal safety and protection. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.
P8-SC \"Red Alert\" SMG.lead_ko: Behring Applied Technology의 기관단총 P8-SC (Red Alert 에디션).
P8-SC \"Red Alert\" SMG.desc_ko: 우주 최강의 전투 부대가 표준 무기로 택했다면 주목할 만하겠죠. Behring이 만든 P8-SC는 처음 생산된 이래 UEE 해병대가 선택한 탄도 기관단총이었고, 이제는 많은 사람이 개인 안전과 호신을 위해 이 총을 믿고 씁니다. 'Red Alert' 에디션은 회색과 강렬한 빨강을 섞어 대담하고 역동적인 디자인을 완성했습니다.

P8-SC SMG Magazine (45 cap).title: P8-SC SMG Magazine (45 cap)
P8-SC SMG Magazine (45 cap).subtitle: Magazine
P8-SC SMG Magazine (45 cap).lead: The P8-SC SMG Magazine (45 cap) is a magazine for the P8-SC SMG , manufactured by Behring Applied Technology . It holds 10 mm rounds.
P8-SC SMG Magazine (45 cap).desc: This magazine for the Behring P8-SC SMG holds forty-five 10mm rounds.
P8-SC SMG Magazine (45 cap).desc_ko: Behring P8-SC 기관단총용 탄창으로, 10mm 탄 45발이 들어갑니다.

Palatino Arms.title: Palatino Arms
Palatino Arms.subtitle: Arm armor
Palatino Arms.lead: The Palatino Arms is the arms of the Palatino armor set manufactured by Quirinus Tech .
Palatino Arms.desc: Elegant design meets innovation with the Palatino armor from Quirinus Tech. This armor set masterfully mixes reinforced plating with patented new materials that are light-weight and flexible, yet rated to withstand heavy damage allowing the wearer to be fashionable, light on their feet, and able to withstand serious firepower.
Palatino Arms.lead_ko: Quirinus Tech의 Palatino 방어구 세트 중 팔 부위.
Palatino Arms.desc_ko: Quirinus Tech의 Palatino 방어구에서 우아한 디자인과 혁신이 만납니다. 강화 장갑판과 가볍고 유연하면서도 큰 피해를 견디는 특허 신소재를 절묘하게 섞어, 멋스럽고 가볍게 움직이면서도 강력한 화력을 버틸 수 있습니다.

Palatino Arms Mark I.subtitle: Arm armor

missions.ko_desc:
Hockrow Agency 
사건 파일 #JD10285
수석 조사관: Arken Mallor

사건 업데이트: 
Onyx에 대한 모든 조사가 성과를 거두었습니다. 나는 Jorrit가 "Project Hyperion"이라고 부르는 실험을 수행하기 위해 시설의 B 사이트에서 비공개 실험실을 운영하고 있음을 확인할 수 있었습니다. 일단 진행되면 그의 <EM4>실험실 노트를 당신의 mobiGlas 저널</EM4>으로 보낼 것입니다. 하지만 요점은 그 놈이 인간을 진화시키려고 하거나 그런 말도 안 되는 일을 하려고 한다는 것입니다.

클라이언트가 실험 데이터를 원하므로 당신은 Onyx로 돌아가서 프로젝트 Hyperion을 시작하고 실행하는 데 필요한 모든 작업을 수행해야 합니다.

missions.ko_desc:
Hockrow Agency 
사건 파일 #JD10285
수석 조사관: Arken Mallor

사건 업데이트: 
Onyx에 대한 모든 조사가 성과를 거두었습니다. 나는 Jorrit가 "Project Hyperion"이라고 부르는 실험을 수행하기 위해 시설의 B 사이트에서 비공개 실험실을 운영하고 있음을 확인할 수 있었습니다. 일단 진행되면 그의 <EM4>실험실 노트를 당신의 mobiGlas 저널</EM4>으로 보낼 것입니다. 하지만 요점은 그 놈이 인간을 진화시키려고 하거나 그런 말도 안 되는 일을 하려고 한다는 것입니다.

클라이언트가 실험 데이터를 원하므로 당신은 Onyx로 돌아가서 프로젝트 Hyperion을 시작하고 실행하는 데 필요한 모든 작업을 수행해야 합니다. 

계약 조사자 조치:
엔지니어링 윙</EM4>에서 <EM4>시약 코드와 연구 윙</EM4>에서 <EM4>Catalyst 코드를 수집하여 실험을 준비합니다.

이러한 정보를 확보한 후 B기지</EM4>에 있는 <EM4>연구소로 가서 <EM4>실험을 실행</EM4>하여 <EM4>업로드할 수 있습니다. results</EM4>.

추가 참고 사항:
이 연구실은 활성 연구실이므로 현장에 ASD 보안이 있을 수 있습니다.
 
대형 격납고에 보관할 수 있는 차량을 타고 Onyx로 이동하세요.

missions.en_desc:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his <EM4>lab notes to your mobiGlas journal</EM4> once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a <EM4>Reagent code from the Engineering wing</EM4> and a <EM4>Catalyst code from the Research wing</EM4>.

Once you have those, head down to the <EM4>Lab in Site-B</EM4> and <EM4>run the experiment</EM4> so you can <EM4>upload the results</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

RSI Apollo Triage Wikelo Sneak Special.title: Apollo Triage
RSI Apollo Triage Wikelo Sneak Special.subtitle: Roberts Space Industries
RSI Apollo Triage Wikelo Sneak Special.lead: The Apollo Triage is an armored medical aerospace-craft manufactured by Roberts Space Industries for use when a ground-based medical facility is not available. Combining the ambulance capabilities of the Drake Cutlass Red with the advanced medical technology found in much larger facilities, the Apollo is the gold standard in medical evacuation and rapid emergency care, having provided critical aid to the known universe for over two centuries. When one thinks of first-class medical rescue, one thinks of the RSI Apollo.

RSI Meteor Wikelo Sneak Special.title: Meteor
RSI Meteor Wikelo Sneak Special.subtitle: Roberts Space Industries
RSI Meteor Wikelo Sneak Special.lead: The Meteor is a medium fighter based on the Mantis chassis and developed by Roberts Space Industries . Equipped with strong weapons, this medium fighter distinguishes itself by combining elements of heavy fighters, medium interceptors, and light fighters. It has powerful armament, superb flight capabilities, hull durability, and specialises in straight-line speed. By focusing on securing victory in an initial strike, the Meteor poses a serious challenge to foes.
RSI Meteor Wikelo Sneak Special.lead_ko: RSI가 Mantis 기체를 바탕으로 만든 중형 전투기. 중전투기와 중형 요격기의 장점을 합쳤습니다. 위켈로 'Sneak Special' 버전.

RSI Polaris Wikelo Special.title: Polaris
RSI Polaris Wikelo Special.subtitle: Roberts Space Industries
RSI Polaris Wikelo Special.lead: The Polaris is a corvette-class capital ship developed by Roberts Space Industries (RSI) for the United Empire of Earth Navy (UEEN). Designed for use as both a naval patrol ship and to serve as the flagship of civilian militia operations, the Polaris has the capacity to perform search & rescue operations, strike missions and general security patrols. While intended for combat situations, the Polaris can also operate as a command center while providing refuel and repair capabilities from its single small fighter bay.
RSI Polaris Wikelo Special.lead_ko: RSI가 UEE 해군을 위해 만든 코르벳급 주력함. 해군 초계함이자 민간 민병대의 기함 역할을 합니다. 위켈로 'Special' 버전.

RSI Scorpius Wikelo Sneak Special.title: Scorpius
RSI Scorpius Wikelo Sneak Special.subtitle: Roberts Space Industries
RSI Scorpius Wikelo Sneak Special.lead: The Scorpius is a two-seat heavy fighter developed by Roberts Space Industries Applied Innovations division. It is designed as the latest advancement in heavy combat, interception, and dogfighting capabilities. Featuring a versatile bi-wing design and an innovative rail-mounted remote turret, the Scorpius provides exceptional fire coverage for both defensive and offensive operations. It stands as the quintessential enforcer, serving as an ideal addition to any combat-ready fleet aiming to instill fear in its adversaries through the delivery of justice.
RSI Scorpius Wikelo Sneak Special.lead_ko: RSI 응용혁신부의 2인승 중전투기. 중전투·요격·근접전 능력을 고루 갖췄습니다. 위켈로 'Sneak Special' 버전.

RSI Ursa Medivac Wikelo Special.title: Ursa Medivac
RSI Ursa Medivac Wikelo Special.subtitle: Roberts Space Industries
RSI Ursa Medivac Wikelo Special.lead: The RSI Ursa Medivac (also known as Nursa) is an all-terrain medical ground vehicle. It plays a crucial role in delivering vital medical assistance to the forefront of any land-based mission. By incorporating a tier 3 med-bed into the already esteemed attributes of RSI's Ursa, such as its exceptional speed, maneuverability, and resilience, the notion of failure is no longer intertwined with death and dismemberment. The Ursa Medivac ensures that your severely injured infantry does not have to endure a prolonged wait before rejoining the battle. Swiftly mend their wounds and swiftly return them to the forefront of action with the Ursa Medivac.
RSI Ursa Medivac Wikelo Special.lead_ko: RSI의 전지형 의료 지상 차량(일명 Nursa). 3단계 의료 침대로 지상 작전 최전선에 의료 지원을 제공합니다. 위켈로 'Special' 버전.

RSI Zeus Mk II CL.title: Zeus Mk II CL
RSI Zeus Mk II CL.subtitle: Roberts Space Industries
RSI Zeus Mk II CL.lead: The Zeus Mk II CL , manufactured by Roberts Space Industries , is a multi-crew medium cargo hauler. The Zeus features respectable firepower, comprehensive crew amenities, and a generous cargo capacity. The onboard tractor beam also greatly expedites freight handling.
RSI Zeus Mk II CL.lead_ko: RSI의 다인승 중형 화물선. 괜찮은 화력, 승무원 편의 시설, 넉넉한 화물 공간과 트랙터 빔을 갖췄습니다.

RSI Zeus Mk II ES Wikelo Work Special.title: Zeus Mk II ES
RSI Zeus Mk II ES Wikelo Work Special.subtitle: Roberts Space Industries
RSI Zeus Mk II ES Wikelo Work Special.lead: Roberts Space Industries has developed the Zeus Mk II ES , a multi-crew exploratory spacecraft specifically engineered for the purpose of exploration. This vessel features a cutting-edge radar system that facilitates the efficient identification of new discoveries. Furthermore, the ES is enhanced with sophisticated weaponry and protective shielding, ensuring the secure return of both the crew and the discoveries acquired throughout the mission.
RSI Zeus Mk II ES Wikelo Work Special.key: RSI Zeus Mk II ES Wikelo Work Special
RSI Zeus Mk II ES Wikelo Work Special.lead_ko: RSI의 다인승 탐사선. 첨단 레이더 시스템으로 효율적인 탐사를 돕습니다. 위켈로 'Work Special' 버전.

Ravager-212 \"Red Alert\" Twin Shotgun.subtitle: Personal weapon

Ravager-212 \"Red Alert\" Twin Shotgun.desc: The Kastak Arms Ravager-212 Twin shotgun earns its name from its unique dual-barrels that allow for multiple ammo types to be used in conjunction with each other for maximum tactical possibilities. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.

Strata Arms.desc: Made for miners but ready for any adventure, Greycat Industrial's Strata armor provides premium protection and convenient features. Testudo Helmet Clanguard.desc_ko: Testudo 헬멧으로 목표에 집중하면서 머리를 지키세요. 넓은 안면판과, 충격 에너지를 흡수해 효율적으로 분산하도록 이마 위로 튀어나온 단단한 외피가 특징입니다. Clanguard 버전은 반두르 재료와 외계 유물로 개조했습니다.

Testudo Helmet Turfwar.title: Testudo Helmet Turfwar
Testudo Helmet Turfwar.subtitle: Helmet
Testudo Helmet Turfwar.lead: The Testudo Helmet Turfwar is a helmet from the Testudo armor set, manufactured by Quirinus Tech .
Testudo Helmet Turfwar.desc: Keep your eyes on the prize and your head protected with the Testudo helmet. It features a wide faceplate and a durable outer shell that protrudes above the forehead in a way specifically designed to absorb and efficiently disperse the energy of impacts.
Testudo Helmet Turfwar.lead_ko: Quirinus Tech의 Testudo 방어구 세트 헬멧 (Turfwar 도색).
Testudo Helmet Turfwar.desc_ko: Testudo 헬멧으로 목표에 집중하면서 머리를 지키세요. 넓은 안면판과, 충격 에너지를 흡수해 효율적으로 분산하도록 이마 위로 튀어나온 단단한 외피가 특징입니다.

Testudo Legs Clanguard.title: Testudo Legs Clanguard
Testudo Legs Clanguard.subtitle: Leg armor
Testudo Legs Clanguard.lead: The Testudo Legs Clanguard are the legs of a Clanguard variant of the Testudo armor set, manufactured by Quirinus Tech .
Testudo Legs Clanguard.desc: The Testudo armor for Quirinus Tech blends battlefield durability with everyday comfort. It weaves tough, yet lightweight, plating with ultra-strong synthetic fibers to provide premium protection. Lining the inside is a proprietary micromodal fabric that's soft to the touch and wicks away moisture for supreme comfort. The Clanguard version has been modified with Vanduul materials and alien artifacts.
Testudo Legs Clanguard.lead_ko: Quirinus Tech의 Testudo 방어구 세트 다리 (Clanguard 도색).
Testudo Legs Clanguard.desc_ko: Quirinus Tech의 Testudo 방어구는 전장의 내구성과 일상의 편안함을 함께 갖췄습니다. 튼튼하면서도 가벼운 장갑판을 초강력 합성 섬유와 엮어 고급 보호력을 제공하고, 안쪽에는 부드럽고 땀을 잘 흡수하는 독자 마이크로모달 원단을 덧대 최상의 착용감을 줍니다. Clanguard 버전은 반두르 재료와 외계 유물로 개조했습니다.

Testudo Legs Turfwar.title: Testudo Legs Turfwar
Testudo Legs Turfwar.subtitle: Leg armor
Testudo Legs Turfwar.lead: The Testudo Legs Turfwar are the legs of a Turfwar variant of the Testudo armor set, manufactured by Quirinus Tech .
Testudo Legs Turfwar.desc: The Testudo armor for Quirinus Tech blends battlefield durability with everyday comfort. It weaves tough, yet lightweight, plating with ultra-strong synthetic fibers to provide premium protection. Lining the inside is a proprietary micromodal fabric that's soft to the touch and wicks away moisture for supreme comfort.
Testudo Legs Turfwar.lead_ko: Quirinus Tech의 Testudo 방어구 세트 다리 (Turfwar 도색).
Testudo Legs Turfwar.desc_ko: Quirinus Tech의 Testudo 방어구는 전장의 내구성과 일상의 편안함을 함께 갖췄습니다. 튼튼하면서도 가벼운 장갑판을 초강력 합성 섬유와 엮어 고급 보호력을 제공하고, 안쪽에는 부드럽고 땀을 잘 흡수하는 독자 마이크로모달 원단을 덧대 최상의 착용감을 줍니다.

Tevarin War Service Marker (Pristine).title: Tevarin War Service Marker (Pristine)
Tevarin War Service Marker (Pristine).subtitle: Misc item
Tevarin War Service Marker (Pristine).lead: Tevarin War Service Marker (Pristine) is a marker awarded to combatants of the First Tevarin War , in a pristine state.
Tevarin War Service Marker (Pristine).desc: A service marker awarded by the United Planets of Earth (UPE) to all members of the military who served during the First Tevarin War. Though many were produced in their time, those numbers have dwindled significantly and collectors are eager to pick up any found. Well-preserved despite its age, this marker is considered in pristine condition and features clean etchings and minimal wear.
Tevarin War Service Marker (Pristine).lead_ko: 제1차 테바린 전쟁 참전 군인에게 수여된 기념 표식 (손상 없는 상태).
Tevarin War Service Marker (Pristine).desc_ko: 지구 연합 행성(UPE)이 제1차 테바린 전쟁에 복무한 모든 군인에게 수여한 복무 표식입니다. 당시에는 많이 만들어졌지만 지금은 수가 크게 줄어, 수집가들이 발견되는 대로 모으려 합니다. 오래됐지만 보존 상태가 좋아 손상 없는 것으로 보며, 새김이 선명하고 마모가 거의 없습니다.

Tripledown \"Heatwave\" Pistol.title: Tripledown "Heatwave" Pistol
Tripledown \"Heatwave\" Pistol.subtitle: Personal weapon
Tripledown \"Heatwave\" Pistol.lead: The Tripledown "Heatwave" Pistol is a sidearm of unknown provenance.
Tripledown \"Heatwave\" Pistol.desc: Firing three shotgun shells with each pull of the trigger thanks to it's triple-barrel construction, the bolt-action Tripledown pistol is ready to blast its way through anything from the smallest disagreements to massive dustups. The Heatwave edition is primarily black with glowing red highlights.
Tripledown \"Heatwave\" Pistol.lead_ko: 출처를 알 수 없는 권총 Tripledown (Heatwave 에디션).
Tripledown \"Heatwave\" Pistol.desc_ko: 3총열 구조 덕분에 방아쇠를 당길 때마다 산탄 세 발을 쏘는 볼트액션 Tripledown 권총은 사소한 다툼부터 대형 난투까지 무엇이든 뚫고 나갈 준비가 돼 있습니다. Heatwave 에디션은 검은 바탕에 붉게 빛나는 포인트가 들어갔습니다.

Tripledown Pistol.title: Tripledown Pistol
Tripledown Pistol.subtitle: Personal weapon
Tripledown Pistol.lead: The "Tripledown" a.k.a. the "Triple Threat" a.k.a. the "Negotiator" is a triple-barrel mag-drum-loaded bolt-action buckshot-firing Pistol . It is of typical Grey's Market quality and provenance.
Tripledown Pistol.desc: Firing three shotgun shells with each pull of the trigger thanks to it's triple-barrel construction, the bolt-action Tripledown pistol is ready to blast its way through anything from the smallest disagreements to massive dustups.
Tripledown Pistol.lead_ko: '트리플 스렛', '네고시에이터'라고도 불리는 3총열 볼트액션 산탄 권총. 전형적인 Grey's Market 품질입니다.
Tripledown Pistol.desc_ko: 3총열 구조 덕분에 방아쇠를 당길 때마다 산탄 세 발을 쏘는 볼트액션 Tripledown 권총은 사소한 다툼부터 대형 난투까지 무엇이든 뚫고 나갈 준비가 돼 있습니다.

Tripledown Pistol Magazine (12 Cap).title: Tripledown Pistol Magazine (12 Cap)
Tripledown Pistol Magazine (12 Cap).subtitle: Magazine
Tripledown Pistol Magazine (12 Cap).lead: The Tripledown Pistol Magazine (12 Cap) is a magazine for the Tripledown pistol, loaded with buckshot rounds.
Tripledown Pistol Magazine (12 Cap).desc: This magazine for the Tripledown pistol comes with twelve buckshot rounds.
Tripledown Pistol Magazine (12 Cap).desc_ko: Tripledown 권총용 탄창으로, 벅샷 12발이 들어 있습니다.

Tundra Kopion Horn.title: Tundra Kopion Horn
Tundra Kopion Horn.subtitle: Misc item
Tundra Kopion Horn.lead: Tundra Kopion Horn are horns from the Tundra Kopion , found in the grasslands immediately adjacent to the snow-covered lowlands of microTech .
Tundra Kopion Horn.desc: The horn of the kopion is made of a unique combination of bone and naturally-occurring carbon nanomaterials. When properly processed, it can be used to aid in bone regeneration with a far greater rate of success than lab-grown materials. This application has made it a valuable commodity.
Tundra Kopion Horn.lead_ko: 마이크로텍(microTech)의 눈 덮인 저지대 바로 옆 초원에 사는 툰드라 코피온의 뿔.
Tundra Kopion Horn.desc_ko: 코피온의 뿔은 뼈와 천연 탄소 나노물질이 독특하게 결합된 것입니다. 제대로 가공하면 실험실에서 기른 재료보다 훨씬 높은 성공률로 뼈 재생을 도울 수 있어, 귀한 원자재로 취급됩니다.

Tungsten.title: Tungsten
Tungsten.subtitle: Metal
Tungsten.lead: Tungsten is a metal refined from tungsten ore.
Tungsten.desc: Used in many different alloys, tungsten in its pure form becomes malleable while maintaining its hardness.

UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).title: UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine)
UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).subtitle: Misc item
UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).lead: UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine) is a pristine medal from the United Empire of Earth Marines 6th platoon.
UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).desc: A medal given to members of the UEE Marines 6th Platoon for distinguished service. The esteemed 6th Platoon 'Phantoms' have received this honor on numerous occasions, including for operations during the Second Tevarin War, on the Vanduul front and for rescuing a UEE survey team taken hostage by the Outsiders on Leir III. The excellent appearance of the ribbon and etchings on the observe have left this medal in pristine condition.
UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).lead_ko: UEE 해병대 제6소대의 메달 (손상 없는 상태).
UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine).desc_ko: 뛰어난 공을 세운 UEE 해병대 제6소대원에게 주는 메달. 이름난 제6소대 '팬텀'은 제2차 테바린 전쟁 작전, 반두르 전선, 레이어 III에서 아웃사이더에게 인질로 잡힌 UEE 조사팀 구출 등으로 이 영예를 여러 번 받았습니다. 리본과 앞면 새김 상태가 훌륭해 손상 없는 상태로 남아 있습니다.

Vanduul Metal.title: Vanduul Metal
Vanduul Metal.subtitle: Misc item
Vanduul Metal.lead: The Vanduul Metal is a crafting item found on Vanduul (pilot) bodies in Nyx.
Vanduul Metal.desc: A piece of metal of Vanduul origin.
Vanduul Metal.lead_ko: 닉스(Nyx)의 반두르(Vanduul) 조종사 시체에서 얻는 제작 재료.

missions.ko_desc:
임무 사양

작전 지역: 닉스 시스템
적대 세력: 알 수 없음
장비 사양: 전투 등급 함선, 개인 무기
브리핑: InterSec은 UEE에 의해 ASD의 Onyx 시설에서 진행 중인 불법적인 Vanduul 실험과 관련된 <EM4>Vanduul 부품을 거래하는 암거래상</EM4> 그룹에 대한 정보를 수집하기 위해 모집되었습니다. UEE는 자신들의 작전을 파악하고 중단하고자 합니다.

ASD 시설에서 추출한 증거를 바탕으로, 저희는 그들의 저장 시설 중 하나의 위치를 ​​추적했을 가능성이 있습니다.

경의를 표합니다.

InterSec Defense Solutions

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Unknown
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms

missions.ko_desc:
임무 사양

작전 지역: 닉스 성계
적대 세력: 무법자 존재 및 무장
장비 사양: 전투 등급 함선, 개인 무기
브리핑: InterSec에 다시 한번 당신의 도움이 필요합니다.

이전에 수집하신 정보는 불법으로 획득한 반둘 부품의 주요 구매자들을 파악하는 데 매우 귀중한 자료가 되었습니다. 그러나 그 이후로도 샤터드 블레이드는 작전을 계속해 왔으며, UEE은 <EM4>정보 업데이트</EM4>를 요청하고 있습니다.

구 <EM4>QV 물류 기지</EM4>에 위치한 저장 시설에서 더 많은 정보를 얻을 수 있을 것으로 예상됩니다.

작전 조건은 지난 임무 이후 변경되지 않았습니다. <EM4>암호화된 데이터</EM4>를 찾아 <EM4>복호화 키</EM4>를 사용하여 목록을 해독하여 우리에게 업로드해 주십시오. 지난번 공격 이후 'Shattered Blade'가 해당 지역을 강화했으니 저항이 예상됩니다.

행운을 빕니다. 연락드리겠습니다.


경의를 표합니다.

Deacon Tobin
운영 관리자
InterSec Defense Solutions

본 통신은 수신자 본인에게만 제공되는 기밀 정보입니다. 수신 오류가 있을 경우 무시하고 발신자에게 알려주시기 바랍니다. 모든 작업은 계약자 본인의 책임 하에 수행되며, UEE 및 해당되는 경우 시스템 법률을 준수해야 합니다.

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec needs your services once again.

The intel you previously gathered has been invaluable in identifying several prominent buyers of the illegally-obtained Vanduul parts. However, since then the Shattered Blade have continued their operations and the UEE is requesting that we <EM4>update our intel.</EM4>

We believe more information can be retrieved from the storage facilities located at the old <EM4>QV Logistics station.</EM4>

The operation parameters haven’t changed since your last mission: find the <EM4>encrypted data</EM4> and use the <EM4>decryption key</EM4> to decipher and upload the list to us. The Shattered Blade will have reinforced the area since the last time, so expect resistance.

Good luck. We’ll be in touch.


Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
